headline: Kings’ Kevin Fiala to make season debut vs. Islanders
take: Daily Faceoff reports Kevin Fiala makes his season debut against the Islanders, his first game since the leg injury he suffered playing for Switzerland at the Winter Olympics in February. For the Kings, he can't come soon enough. Los Angeles is 5-9-2, but the hockey has been better than the record: the Kings have 51% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), and they've scored about 5.5 fewer goals than those chances deserved. Fiala is a finisher on a team that has been short of finishing, so his return addresses the right problem. The other problem is in net, where the Kings have allowed about 6.4 more goals than expected. The Islanders are a decent place to restart: they give up 3.53 expected goals per 60, and their record (7-6-4) leans on goaltending that has saved about 11 goals more than expected.
